title: Concept: Overly open CORS (php) — review required
description: In php, header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *") accepts origins beyond the application's own, so other sites can read responses that carry the user's session. The remedy is an explicit list of trusted origins (an explicit origin), without credentials for wildcards.
applicability: php API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
